summary: Completed comprehensive K-BRAIN feature testing (backend + frontend). All core functionality working: persona management, briefing with live data, handover flow with card confirmation/dismissal/undo, chat reset, and floating panel UI. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: 7/7 tests passed.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/me returns brain_persona (chief_of_staff) and 4 personas list
Backend: PUT /api/me/brain-persona returns 400 for invalid persona
Backend: POST /api/chat/stream returns briefing with real data (addresses user by first name, mentions pending approvals with Indian number formatting ₹42,000, ₹8,500, ₹6,800)
Backend: Handover message creates proper card with to_name='Priya Nair', message, restrictions, until
Backend: POST /api/chat/cards/{id}/confirm on handover - status becomes 'confirmed', creates rule, creates thread message, second confirm is no-op (no duplicate rule)
Backend: POST /api/chat/cards/{id}/dismiss on handover - status becomes 'dismissed'
Backend: POST /api/chat/cards/{id}/undo on confirmed handover - status becomes 'ended', rule made inactive
Backend: Persona change via chat creates persona card and updates member.brain_persona
Backend: POST /api/chat/reset archives messages (10 archived), work items untouched
Backend: Regression tests passed (dashboard, items, members, approvals all working)
Frontend: K-BRAIN dock visible on /app/dashboard and other pages
Frontend: K-BRAIN dock correctly hidden on /app/chat
Frontend: Chat page has all elements (persona-select, reset-button, composer-textarea, send-button, attach-button, mic-button)
Frontend: K-BRAIN panel opens from dock, has title/persona/expand/minimize buttons, closes on minimize
Frontend: Theme toggle switches between light/dark modes
Frontend: Mobile 390px layout correct (dock + bottom tabs visible)
Frontend: Page regression - all pages load (dashboard, work, team, approvals)
